Standard: The air vehicle has sufficient control power to maintain control (pitch attitude, AOA, bank angle, heading, pitch rate, and specific excess energy) during launch assisted takeoffs through transition to normal flight. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the control power, engine response, and margin to stall speed needed to maintain control and complete the flyaway from minimum end airspeed to maximum speed (to include any potential system motion effects, 2-D performance analysis for pitch-rate control, 6-DOF simulations for automatic control and trim settings for controls free launches, and release dynamics) for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the control power, engine response, and margin to stall speed needed to maintain control and complete the flyaway from minimum end airspeed to maximum speed, including any potential system motion effects, automatic control and trim settings for controls free launches, and release dynamics, for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the control power, engine response, and margin to stall speed needed to maintain control and complete the flyaway from minimum end airspeed to maximum speed, including any potential system motion effects, automatic control and trim settings for controls free launches, and release dynamics, for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions.
